description: List the links (Verknuepfungen) of the document, optionally filtered by path_contains (substring of path or file name, case-insensitive). Per link: link_id, file_name, file_path, status (NORMAL, LINK_MISSING, LINK_OUT_OF_DATE, EMBEDDED), page_id, page_name and frame_id (for a linked story file such as an InCopy story: its first text frame and the page of that frame). Also count. Where the holding object lies: container_id (the frame or object that holds the graphic, also when it lies on no page; for a linked story file its first text frame), container_type, graphic_type (InDesign class of the linked object, e.g. Image, PDF, EPS, Story), location (page, parent_page, pasteboard, anchored – in a story, then with story_id and in_overset true when the anchor sits in overset text –, or unknown), spread_id (the spread or parent spread of the object; for anchored objects the spread of the text frame, null in overset). For an object anchored in overset text InDesign still reports a page_id (the page it would follow) – in_overset true is the reliable sign. A link with page_id null and location pasteboard or anchored with in_overset true is a leftover that does not print – delete_link removes it, list_pasteboard_items lists all pasteboard objects. Use it to match pictures to articles by page number or to spot motifs of old issues by file name. Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

path_contains.description: Substring of the file path or name.

name: list_links
title: List links
